evidence.cost_assumption: self_quant turnover cost diagnostics available; after-cost annual return remains weak for best gross variant
evidence.falsification: If OOS or official backend evidence shows the high-amount/turnover-penalty improvement is only cost or size exposure, keep as model feature and do not promote standalone.
evidence.portfolio_policy: long-side top group / diagnostic deciles; long-short only diagnostic

variant_family_coverage.scope: ALPHA015 historical ordinary/knowledge/iteration records are mapped to this mechanism-family node; individual variants still require their own artifact review before promotion.

evidence.window: 20160101 through available IS evidence in Alpha015 library records

mechanism.complexity_penalty_reasoning: High-amount and turnover-penalty gates are complexity that looks economically motivated because they target payer quality and trading cost, but promotion still requires OOS and after-cost proof.
mechanism.dirac_style_forced_insight: The short rolling sum forces the object to be path persistence of rank-correlation pressure, not a single-day volume spike; useful revisions should condition the pressure source, not replace the path object with a portfolio rule.
mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Repeated high-rank correlation between high-price ranks and volume ranks measures a recent volume-pressure path; high-amount and moderate turnover conditions strengthen the chance that pressure is institutional or constraint-driven rather than random noise.
mechanism.factor_expression: (-1 * sum(rank(correlation(rank(high), rank(volume), 3)), 3)); strongest variants include high-amount half-low-turn and turnover penalty A060.
mechanism.information_preserved_removed: The rank/correlation/sum stack preserves ordinal repeated pressure and removes absolute scale; high-amount and turnover-penalty revisions reintroduce capacity/tradability information but must be paid for by after-cost evidence.
mechanism.payer: benchmark-constrained, liquidity-constrained, or execution-driven participants whose demand creates repeated high-rank volume-pressure states
mechanism.random_object: rolling correlation of ranked high price and ranked volume, accumulated over a short path window
mechanism.receiver: stat-arb or portfolio-construction capital using the ordinal pressure state as a long-side feature
mechanism.target_statistic: long-side gross return and Rank IC, then after-cost long-side capital efficiency

relations.note: The formula sums a short path of ranked high-volume correlations.
Negative sign maps repeated volume-pressure correlation into a repair/reversal interpretation.
Strong ordinal evidence and weak after-cost evidence suggest use as a model feature before standalone promotion.
Alpha015 extends the price-volume pressure family from covariance to repeated rank-correlation path persistence.
The best gross branch still has limited after-cost Sharpe.
Use as a candidate feature in ML or composite models, especially with cost and universe controls.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve this node for rank-correlation, high-volume pressure, or Alpha101 price-volume path ideas.
Preserve the rolling path-persistence object when revising; do not replace it with a pure one-day spike score.
Use high-amount and turnover penalties as economically motivated gates, but demand OOS and after-cost proof.
Treat current evidence as candidate-level and feature-ready, not official standalone.
summary: Alpha015 is the strongest migrated Alpha101 daily microstructure candidate so far: high-amount and turnover-penalty variants lift Rank IC and gross long-side Sharpe materially, but drawdown, recovery, turnover cost, and qlib consistency keep it below official standalone admission.
